sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is a multilingual instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama with 8 billion parameters, released July 23, 2024. The model uses an optimized transformer architecture with grouped-query attention (GQA) for efficient inference, trained on approximately 15 trillion tokens of publicly available data with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023. sources.snippet: The workhorse 8B instruction-tuned model. Excellent quality-to-cost ratio and the broadest ecosystem support of any open-weights model — every major inference engine, fine-tuning library, and quantization toolchain has a 3.1 8B preset.
